notes.title: Legendary Hoplite - Major Update
notes.notes:
Defenders of Ithaca,
We are happy to announce that the major update for the game has been released, and you can try it out right now!

[previewyoutube=xr_bTNloSYg;full][/previewyoutube]

This update introduces many new mechanics and an exciting new game mode.
Here’s what you can find:

New Game+ Mode
After completing the main story, unlock New Game+, which will introduce a lot of new content!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40968691/16efe1cc9cb7e626e850f42c0e06da551ef5e9ae.png

New areas and bosses
In New Game+, you will find new areas by defeating bosses or clearing specific zones.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40968691/59ce816ea32f180c63025b513ec0c271cdc829ff.png

Elite Enemies
In the new mode, you will encounter elite enemies, which are far stronger than regular ones but will grant you extra bonuses. And it’s not just the monsters getting stronger - you will, too.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40968691/d7d747970e5da438b27119a789a7fe57ebced690.png

Forge
In New Game+ mode, you’ll be able to upgrade your army even further, making them tougher and more powerful.
Unlock this feature after transitioning to New Game+ and opening the Army panel.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40968691/137d06b89c63e4938cf0dde5f80624dda01ae8ab.png

Craft
Our new crafting system allows you to combine items of the same type to create improved versions. You can even choose which characteristics to apply to these items! 
Unlock this feature after clearing the First Centaur area: Ep1. The Centaur Approach in Chapter 2 in New Game (not New Game+).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40968691/463a371172ce5fe8ea53799aa962494333e02668.png

Ichor
A new currency that allows you to upgrade your Legendary and Arcana items. This currency only drops from elite enemies and as rewards from areas in New Game+.

Enhance Legendary/Arcana Items
You can now upgrade your Legendary and Arcana items with Ichor.
Unlock this feature after clearing the area: Ep1. The War Begins in Chapter 1 in New Game+.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40968691/00b2f9ff93e06eacf6486e637d0cb195a19f87c2.png

Weather
While playing, you might encounter different weather conditions that can put negative effects on your Hero and Army.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40968691/e08649026943bcfb7b23bf1ebe1e042a5d13740a.png

Prime Items
A new type of item. Uncommon or Rare items have a small chance to become Prime Uncommon or Prime Rare items. Prime items feature a new passive ability and a unique affix.

New War Techniques
12 new War Techniques have been added.

New Legendary/Arcana Items
Arcana Sets and Legendary items are now accessible through gameplay.

New Encyclopedia
Bosses: You can now learn lore and skills from bosses after meeting them for the first time.
Elite Enemies: Learn skills from elite enemies after entering New Game+.
Legendary/Arcana Items: Discover lore from Legendary and Arcana items after acquiring them.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40968691/b30cc4ac4213f9aa55572d33808277a43ff6c4bc.png

Balance
We’ve adjusted the game’s balance to make it even more enjoyable and challenging to play.
We hope you enjoy this major update and all the exciting new features it brings!

As part of the Steam Autumn Sale, Legendary Hoplite is now available at a 75% discount - this is your chance to join the defenders of Ithaca!

Hello Defenders of Ithaca,
We’ve been working hard on the new major update since our last update, and we are excited to tell you that the wait is almost over.

While we are polishing the update, here are some of the cool new features you can expect:

New Game+ Mode 
You’ve beaten the story, but want even more of a challenge? Or you are so good at defending, that the game is too short for you even on the hardest settings? In this update, you will be able to start a New Game+. Expect more enemies, more weapons, and new mechanics.

Forge 
Have you already maxed out your army? With the forge, you can upgrade them even further, making them stronger to withstand the massive waves of monsters.

Craft

Prime Items

Balance

ENEMY
Normal Enemy
 Harpy's healing reduction rate to hero increased from 50% to 100%.

Talos Boss
 HP reduced from 42,000 to 39,000.
 All resist reduced from 80% to 60%.
 Damage when hitting the red spot deals 20% more damage.
 Fire aura damage of the second and third phases reduced from 7 to 6.
 Fire aura interval of the second and third phases increased from 0.4 to 0.5.

Stheno
 Fixed the bug where Stheno was being stuck or disappearing after transformation.

[hr][/hr]
ARMY  
Blue Phalanx
 Shield bash stun duration of levels 2, 3, 4, 5 increased from 1.5/1.5/1.5/1.5 to 1.5/1.75/2/3.

 Shield bash now off cooldown when deployed.

 War Technique Avoid chance increased from 20% to 25%.
 War Technique Avoid duration increased from 1.3 to 2.5.

 Stun duration of levels 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 increased from 1.5/1.5/1.5/1.75/2 to 2/2.25/2.5/2.75/3.

HERO

notes.title: Legendary Hoplite | Update v1.3.3
notes.notes:
Hail to you, legendary defenders of Ithaca!

The latest update to Legendary Hoplite is here, providing you with a major bug fix update.

Important If you still encounter issues with FPS, soft-locks (game pauses), or blurriness when using 2K resolution, please first verify that you have the latest version of Legendary Hoplite (v1.3.3). 

To verify your version, simply open the game, select your character, and once you're on the world map screen, look to the bottom right of the screen, the version number can be seen there.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40968691/960be8720ac80f1a0877b9c851b672c081aa4a4d.png

If you are on v1.3.3 and still have this issue, then please can you re-install your game. This is a step that we have tested with numerous people and has been proven to reliably fix the issue. 

Note: Uninstalling and re-installing the game should not remove your game save files, however, we still recommend that you create a manual backup before you do this. Your game save files are located in:

\Users\\AppData\LocalLow\TripleBricks

Important: The AppData folder is hidden by default, if you cannot see it then you will need to change your settings to see hidden folders by:

 From file explorer click on File (top left of the screen)
 Select Change Folder Options
 Click on the "View" tab
 Make sure that the option for "Show hidden files, folders, and drives" is checked.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40968691/96a64aaf10652166d1304d35d7b079f983a5d190.png

Update Changelog

Major Bug Fixes

 Fixed a bug that triggered a never-ending pause / soft lock.
 First attempt to fix the issue where the 2k resolution settings would result in an extremely blurry screen for some players.
 Fixed a bug that caused the game to get stuck (soft-lock) in a never-ending lock.
 Fixed a game crash that triggered when the archer would fire the moonlight arrow.
 Fixed a game crash caused by specific enemies.


Bug Fixes

 Fixed a bug that caused the weapon skills to be permanently locked.
 Fixed a bug where some players could not see the tutorial/info snippets during boss fights.
 Fixed a bug that caused the reward system to obstruct the player's view.
 Fixed a bug that caused specific enemies to be immortal
 Fixed a bug that prevented damage from triggering in various situations
 Fixed an issue that caused the Lion of Cithaeron's attack range to be too high.
 Fixed the translations for the Lunar New Year Event
 Fixed various translation issues with the in-game encyclopedia.

notes.notes:
Greetings again legendary defenders of Ithaca!

Hot on the heels of the update from yesterday, we're back with another update, and this time it's bigger and better!

We want to thank everyone for the feedback, both positive and negative and we thought the best way would be for us to push forward the start of our event to TODAY!

Presenting the Legendary Hoplite Lunar New Year Event!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40968691/c02f5362d359d3fa1aa53ec6b24d4dad73676420.gif


 Special menu for the lunar new year.
 Special missions that are active only in the event, miss them and they're done.
 Complete the tasks for a very special weapon, obtainable only via this event!


This event will run until the 18th of February 2024.

That's not all, we've also released some major balancing adjustments, bug fixes, and difficulty improvements.

Bugfixes

 Fixed all suspected causes of the crashes and soft locks.
Important, we are closely monitoring this situation, we do hope that we've solved it once and for all, however, we will respond quickly should we get any more reports.
 Fixed a bug that caused Stheno to be immortal when it was killed while transforming.
 Fixed the HP of the minotaur.
 Fixed a bug with the Cetus summoner being invulnerable after being defeated while petrified.
 Fix a bug that caused the Minotaur's Descendant's HP to flicker while being hit.
 Fixed an issue with the root skill being far too large in specific situations.


Balance Improvements

 The enemy's health is now dependent on the game's difficulty settings.
 The difficulty modes have changed:
 Normal mode (the default difficulty) is now easier, the enemy health has been reduced (25% reduction) and the player's gate is stronger (50% health increase).
 Hard mode is now what the original normal mode was.
 Casual mode has been removed entirely.
 Insane mode has been added to the game.
 Added a difficulty choice that appears at the start of every location.

notes.title: Legendary Hoplite | Hotfix #1 Tackling Crashes
notes.notes:
Defenders of Ithaca,

We hope that you've been enjoying Legendary Hoplite, we've enjoyed reading the reactions and discussing the various features of the game with you all.

We're happy to announce that we have identified the causes of the various issues and have released a hotfix.

Bugfixes

 Fixed a bug that caused the game to crash when the player exited/ended a match very quickly.
 Fixed a bug that caused the game to crash during the Golden Fleece (sheep) level.
 Fixed a bug that caused issues with the controller/gamepad when you received a weapon as a reward.

Important This issue is not fully fixed, we are unfortunately aware of a few more crash/soft lock situations that result from the controller. We are working to fix them as well.

notes.title: Playtest Update 2 | Share Your Feedback and Win A Key to Heretics Fork!
notes.notes:
Hot on the heels of the first update to our playtest, the second one is now live! With this update, we've focused on optimizing your gameplay, fixing issues, and enhancing the overall performance of the game.

Your Feedback Matters!
We're dedicated to making Legendary Hoplite the best it can be, and this is where you come in! If you have insights or suggestions, particularly related to chapters 2 and 3, we'd love to hear from you. Your feedback will help us continue improving your gaming experience. 

How to Provide Feedback?
So, how does one provide feedback? Well, we’ve taken steps to make this as easy as possible, so you’ve got three ways to do so!

In-game
The easiest way possible is directly from the game. In the main menu (as seen below) you will see a Feedback button. Clicking on this button (take a look at the screenshot below) will open a Google form in your default web browser.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40968691/bd81f9a8dbb6cb761bf8941097a3fe5822a39e40.png

What’s more, you’ll see further prompts when you go to exit the game, as you can see in this screenshot.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40968691/31e74c6073111ca600f94356c62c143bbc09f0fb.png

Directly via the Google Form
You don’t need to open the game to access the Google form. You can access it directly via this link.

In our Discord Server
A third option exists in our Discord Server, there, you can chat with other fans of Legendary Hoplite, and even ask questions directly to the team!

Important: To be added to the game credits (more information in the "Appreciating your Contribution section) and be entered into the raffle, we do require you to provide feedback in the Google form linked above.

Join our Discord today!

Appreciating your Contribution

As a special token of our appreciation, we'll add the names of contributors to the game credits! That’s not all, we’ve got 10 keys to the amazing game Heretics Fork that we’re going to raffle for everyone who provides us with feedback for chapters 2 and 3.

Have you already given us feedback using our form? Don’t worry, you can add another one without any issues.

Join us in making the Legendary Hoplite legendary in every way – not only through your gameplay but also as a valued member of our game development community.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40968691/a0b6be0701de6be01af69f83620060101dd97c39.gif

Update Changelog
Faster Loading Times

Loading times have been significantly optimized, ensuring that everything in the game loads much faster. Say goodbye to those long waits and dive straight into the action.

Speedy Map Loading

notes.title: Playtest Update 1 - Of Bosses and Balancing!
notes.notes:
Greetings valiant defenders of Ithaca,

A week has passed since the playtest started and we’ve already received a plethora of feedback, ranging from high praise to some extremely constructive criticism, and with such an amazing reaction, it’s only natural that we respond. 

So, without further ado, let us dive into what we’ve learned so far, and how we’re addressing the points in our first update.


Balancing
One point that almost every tester has brought up in their feedback was that certain bosses in the first area were simply too hard. This prompted us to have a look at the game and we indeed noticed that the vast majority of testers did not reach chapter 2, and far fewer reached chapter 3. 

The culprit of this? The Arachne from chapter 1, episode 10, and to a lesser extent, Ajax the Great from chapter 1, episode 6.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40968691/833b06a4b19af4cde3a3dfb2ca4a61ee775d4340.png

Simply put, these bosses were the epitome of the distinguished title “cheating haxx0r n00b”, or simply put OP. What’s more, when we looked into this, we found that it was almost impossible to defeat them unless you had a set of very specific weapons, all of which had a very low drop rate.

As such, giving these bosses a slight nerf was our number 1 priority, for those that enjoyed the challenge, fret ye not as they will still be worthy advisories, it’s just that they will no longer be impossible to defeat unless you have specific weapons.

A Call to Arms - Chapters 2 and 3
With the aforementioned bosses made easier to manage, we’ve got a special request to make, let us know what you think of chapters 2 and 3

The feedback that we’ve received for Chapter 1 has been amazing and has resulted in a lot of bugfixes, balancing, and general improvements made to the game, however, many of these were specific to Chapter 1. 

Therefore, we’re going to be giving some special attention to chapters 2 and 3, and we hope that you who enjoy the game will join in as well!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40968691/09a36fcd6addc543fc9a5a3aec09561de341525d.gif

Bug Fixes
As well as addressing the major issues that we mentioned above, we’re sure that you’ll all be pleased to know that we’ve also worked on correcting a host of bugs. A sample of what we’ve fixed is:

 Stheno no longer gets stuck at random.
 You can now parry Sthenos laser.
 Stheno and Arachne now have a proper death animation
 The Assassin Satyr should no longer crash the game.
 An issue preventing players from playing the second half of chapter 3 (due to the map size) has been fixed.
 Various images were missing in our game’s encyclopedia.
 And of course, many many more minor bug fixes.

notes.title: Devlog #1 | Enemy Update!
notes.notes:
Good day, Soldiers!

We haven’t made any of these updates in such a long time, but we’re still working on updating the game using your feedback to make it better and better!
This batch of new content is available in the full game and it’s all about enemies since you can’t have enough, now into the good stuff;

            New Enemies    
🕷️ New Spiders
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40968691/b791865099508ef83b0e4437ad81031689067d15.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40968691/59bbe57fffceccc4e34b31197574c0f9d4dcef62.jpg

💀 New Type of Skeletons

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40968691/256f435ad74601ee58364a7523d30ebdd39d51fb.jpg

🐺 New Wolves

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40968691/3aba3e4b132c398a0408dd8816f694e72b1455b3.jpg

🪄 New Majestic Creatures

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40968691/249e9c3d511592f6126a06cb90332b63e92d074d.jpg


 Introducing new classes of Enemies!

We’re introducing a new concept of enemies called Elite Enemies which are divided into 3 different classes to classify the strength as well as determine the quality of the items it drops when it is killed.

            Slayer Enemies    
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40968691/9907a4d5eedac2c332d0f8f85d0eb885b185b108.jpg

Slayer Enemies are normal enemies with a twist, they pack a larger punch than their regular peers, they appear in hordes of 3 to 7 spread out across the lane. They also come with a little not so pleasant gift, everyone of them comes equipped with one of these randomly selected buffs.

 Bloodthirst: Each attack that hits an enemy allows the attacker to gain back an amount of HP based on the enemy's HP lost by the attack's Physic Damage.

 Assassin: When the skill is activated, change the user to a stealth state. In this state, not being selected by the Army as an attack target and the Evade and Critical Chance stats increase.

 Berserker: After each attack, the attacker's attack speed will increase by a little %, and this effect will stack continuously until the stack is maxed. The stack sequence will reset to 0 when the enemy fails to perform a sequence of attacks (move, stun, freeze, sleep, fear, disarm).

            Champion Enemies    
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40968691/d11b89f231cb4677879cbb01ed7024296b1d8df2.jpg

Champion Enemies are also a pretty strong class of enemies in this game, They have higher stats than Normal and Slayer enemies and they come with little minions. They are equipped with some random skills from the special skill set and an aura that is beneficial to the minions of that Champion itself. Killing the Champion won't affect the progression level.


 Healer: Restores HP for itself and all surrounding minions. Aura restores HP over time to itself and all surrounding minions.

 Warlord: Increases Physical Damage and Block Break for itself and all surrounding minions. Aura increases Physical damage to itself and surrounding minions.
 
 Patron: Increases Physical Resist for itself and all surrounding minions. Aura grants Physic Resistant to itself and surrounding minions.  

            Commander Enemies    
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40968691/b77ca48c2688fcec5d92983da221f43dfdd237d2.jpg

This is by far the most advanced type of enemy we have created in this update. It has the same appearance as the normal enemy but with a distinctive aura around it that you can distinguish. It comes with the following “Gifts”.

 Various thematic visuals such as, Holding a Weapon, comes with different themes and sizes or wearing a mask.
 It has the same abilities as the Champion class but more powerful, don’t get near it.
 Its aura can be stacked with the Champion’s aura.


ːsteamhappyː And that’s all stay tuned to new updates later on! ːsteamhappyː
